title: Update on Feasibility Studies for Seletar MRT Line
what_it_is: Update on Feasibility Studies for Seletar MRT Line

sections.label: Seletar MRT Line feasibility studies
sections.summary: A Member asked the Acting Minister for Transport about the progress of feasibility studies on the Seletar MRT Line, announced in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport what is the progress of feasibility studies on the Seletar MRT Line where plans were first announced in 2019.

sections.label: North East transport accessibility measures
sections.summary: The Minister cites Cross Island Line phases, five new peak hour bus services, enhanced bus services and the travel smart journeys programme as measures for the North East.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the Member's second question with regard to concerns that residents currently have on transport accessibility, we have shared earlier in the House that when the Cross Island Line Phase 1 and Punggol Extension open in the early 2030s, residents in the North and North East will have more options for travelling to many locations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: While the works for the Cross Island Line are happening, in the meantime, we are looking to implement other measures to increase public transport capacity in the North East region.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, since the launch of the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has introduced five new peak hour bus services as alternative options to the NEL and has also enhanced the five existing peak hour bus services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In addition, the LTA has enhanced the travel smart journeys programme earlier this year to encourage commuters in the North East to shift their commutes to off peak periods, or to remode their journeys to eligible express bus services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Lastly, I would also like to mention that we will continue to make enhancements to the bus services under the programme, which I have shared, the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This includes introducing more peak hour express bus services as alternative options for residents to complement busier Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) lines like the North East Line.

sections.label: Seletar Line indicative timeline
sections.summary: The original indicative timeline announced for the Seletar Line was sometime in the 2040s.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The original indicative timeline that was initially announced for the Seletar Line was sometime in the 2040s.

sections.label: Seletar Line feasibility studies ongoing
sections.summary: The feasibility studies are ongoing, and where the line is confirmed feasible, the line is expected to be completed in phases from the 2040s.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As I have shared, the feasibility studies are ongoing and where the studies confirm that the line is feasible, we expect to complete the line in phases from the 2040s.
